title: E0130: Command execution via passthru
plain_english: Passing untrusted input to `passthru()` can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary shell commands on the server.
why_matters: Command injection through `passthru()` can: - Run arbitrary system commands - Read or modify files and databases - Install malware or backdoors - Lead to full server compromise
what_it_checks: `passthru()` calls where the command string contains tainted input
`passthru()` calls with user-controlled command arguments without escaping
